name: nuventa-pos
description: Nuventa POS - Punto de Venta Offline-First para Windows

scripts.check: node --check src/main/api-client.js && node --check src/main/auth-service.js && node --check src/main/index.js && node --check src/main/sync-service.js && node --check src/main/image-cache.js && node --check src/main/local-server.js && node --test test/*.test.js
scripts.build:web: npm run build:frontend && node -e "const{cpSync,rmSync,mkdirSync}=require('fs');const src='../nuventa-frontend-dev/out';const dst='resources/web';rmSync(dst,{recursive:true,force:true});mkdirSync(dst,{recursive:true});cpSync(src,dst,{recursive:true});console.log('Web assets copied to',dst);"
